use_case: Renewal / expiry reminder for a retail motor or health (or life premium-due) policy, same insurer and terms, with insurer-quoted premium and a payment or autopay link; caller = broker, corporate agent or web aggregator (company intermediaries, incl. PoSP-platform brokers)
number_series: MANDATORY 1600xx since 2026-02-15: IRDAI circular of 2026-01-06 is addressed to "All Insurers and Insurance Intermediaries" and bars any service or transactional voice call from other numbers "irrespective of explicit or inferred customer consent" [R03; R01]. A 10-digit or personal mobile CLI = non-compliant. 1600 numbers are allocated circle-wise by TSPs/VNOs [R08; R13]; vendor docs say 140/160 are outbound-only, so callbacks need a separate DID or toll-free number [R11].
dlt_header_template_registration: LWC: the intermediary registers as Principal Entity on DLT; 1600 CLI registered as a voice header with the regulator certificate (IRDAI CoR) and the operator/VNO NOC; one voice content template per message type; the placing entity is the TM (the CPaaS, or the intermediary itself) [R09; R11]. A2P use and CLI ranges pre-declared to the originating operator from ~2026-11-18; the Rs 0.05/min A2P charge does not apply to 1600 [R35 reg 4, 35A].
dnd_ncpr_scrubbing: LAWFUL: service calls are not blocked by DND preferences, and 1600 calls may not be tagged, blocked or filtered [R06; S03]. Condition: zero promotional content, or the whole call becomes promotional [R36 def (av) proviso].
digital_consent_acquisition: Not needed under TCCCPR (bh)(i) for information on a product the customer procured [R35]; TRAI treats reminder-type service messages as inferred consent for the duration of the contract (EMI-reminder analogy, memo para 39) [R36]. Keep evidence that the callee is the policyholder of record.
calling_hours: No TCCCPR time band for service calls [S01; S03]. IRDAI distance-marketing hours follow TRAI/DoT orders [R19 Sch VII 7.3(ii); R26]. A business-hours window is a product choice, not a mandate.
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
call_recording: If the call counts as solicitation (persuading renewal, R23 reg 3(13)), the distance-marketing rules apply: tell the caller the call is recorded and that a voice copy is available; the telemarketer preserves all call recordings and forwards them to the CA, which forwards them to the insurer; calls that end in a policy go to the insurer within 30 days [R19 Sch VII 4(i), 7.3(iv), 8(vi)]. Required records are kept at the intermediary PPB in India or in data centres in India, for at least 10 years [R27 reg 13, 16]. Recordings are personal data under DPDP [S16].
dpdp_act_rules: LWC: renewal is within the contract purpose (s.7(a)) [S16]; VP acts as a processor under an s.8(2) contract; core obligations from ~2027-05-13/14 [S17; S18; R42]. DPDP itself has no localisation, but IRDAI localises the intermediary records [R27 reg 13].
sector_rules: IRDAI layer: (1) persuading a policyholder "to renew" is SOLICITATION [R23 reg 3(13)]; solicitation only by certified persons (broker BQP or AV, CA Specified Person or AV, WA AV) [R20; R19; R22]. From 2027-01-01 every policy is tagged to the salesperson's functional identity, except a policy "solicited directly through the digital platform" of a CA or broker [R18]. (2) Brokers must make sure clients know the expiry date and receive the renewal notice [R20 code of conduct 6], so a neutral reminder is also a servicing duty. (3) Broker core functions (advice, submitting insurer quotations, assisting premium payment u/s 64VB) may not be outsourced "in any manner whatsoever"; tele-calling may be outsourced only to the extent the WA Regs allow [R20 reg 36, 45-46, Sch II Form X]. (4) A telemarketer engaged for distance marketing must be TRAI-registered, hold an IRDAI certificate and use human AVs [R19 defs (d), (q), reg 25]. (5) Every broker, CA and WA must obtain a fresh CoR before 2027-01-31 [R18].
platform_policy: WhatsApp utility template with the payment link, opted-in policyholders only (Rs 0.115) [S29; S31].
penalties_enforcement: A non-1600 service call plus a UCC complaint is handled as an unregistered telemarketer (resource bar or disconnection), plus IRDAI action [R01 9(ii); R03 2(iii); S03 reg 25]. Promotion on a 1600 number draws graded action [S03 reg 25(4)(f)]. IRDAI penalties under the Insurance Act; manner and procedure regs notified 2026.
status_today_2026_10_17: LWC (1600 mandatory; strictly informational content; solicitation boundary unresolved for an AI caller)
status_12m_to_2027_10: LWC + A2P declaration (~2026-11-18) + fresh CoR (2027-01-31) + salesperson tagging (2027-01-01) + DPDP core (~2027-05-13/14)
verdict_post_sales: VIABLE only as a neutral reminder with a same-insurer payment link, placed on the intermediary's own 1600 CLI under its own DLT PE registration, with VP as software operated by the intermediary rather than as its telemarketer. Persuasion, re-quotes and advice go to a certified human.
kill_criterion_check: Kill 5 "no compliant number path": NOT triggered on availability (1600 obtainable via TSPs and VNOs, R08, R09, R11, R15), but untested for a small intermediary. It would trigger if counsel holds that an AI renewal reminder is solicitation needing a certified person on every call.
confidence: high (1600 scope); medium (service vs solicitation boundary); low (AI as "digital platform")

use_case: Same renewal / expiry reminder, but the caller is an Insurance Marketing Firm (IMF; 940 registered, the largest stratum of the in-reach pool)
dlt_header_template_registration: As U6-INS-1. The IMF itself must be the Principal Entity [R09; R11].
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
call_recording: As U6-INS-1. IMF records sit at its PPB in India or in Indian data centres for 10+ years [R27].
sector_rules: IMF Regs reg 3(d) (unchanged by the 2026 amendment): IMF distance marketing may be done only (i) "without engaging tele-marketer(s)", (ii) with prior IRDAI approval, (iii) "only through ISPs", (iv) for tied insurers [R21]. So VP cannot be an IMF's telemarketer, and an AI is not an ISP. From 2027-01-01 every IMF policy is tagged to an ISP, PoSP, AV or other authorised salesperson. Unlike CAs and brokers, IMFs get no digital-platform proviso [R18 ch III (14)]. IMF servicing is limited to tied insurers [R21 3(b)].
penalties_enforcement: As U6-INS-1, plus IMF CoR conditions [R18].
status_today_2026_10_17: UNCLEAR (number path is LWC; an AI calling for an IMF conflicts with reg 3(d) wherever the call is solicitation)
status_12m_to_2027_10: UNCLEAR; tagging to a human ISP from 2027-01-01 tightens it
verdict_post_sales: HIGHEST regulatory risk of the intermediary types. At most: neutral reminders and payment links run by the IMF's own staff and its own 1600 CLI, with an ISP owning every conversation that turns to renewal persuasion. Do not sell to IMFs before counsel answers Q4.
kill_criterion_check: Can trigger kill criterion 5 for the IMF stratum, which matters because IMFs dominate the in-reach pool [l3]. Re-size the pool without IMFs as a sensitivity.
confidence: high (text of reg 3(d)); medium (whether a neutral reminder is "distance marketing")

use_case: Renewal re-quote or switch: quotes from other insurers (motor NCB/IDV re-pricing), add-on or sum-insured upsell, health portability, any discount pitch
number_series: Promotional: 140xx only. It may not ride on a 1600 call, and mixing makes the whole call promotional [R36 (av) proviso; R06; S13]. Treating a cross-insurer quote as promotional is an inference from "promotional material or advertisement of a product or service" (medium).
dlt_header_template_registration: LWC: 140 header and promotional template; A2P declared [S02; R35 reg 4].
dnd_ncpr_scrubbing: LWC: 140 calls are scrubbed. Customers who have blocked promotions need Explicit Consent registered in the Consent Register; an existing relationship does not override BLOCK PROMO [S03; l1 U6].
digital_consent_acquisition: LWC: explicit digital consent via the Consent Register; legacy-consent upload so far piloted only with banks [S09; S03].
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
call_recording: Distance-marketing solicitation rules apply in full: insurer-approved standardised scripts, explicit consent to proceed, language choice, recording notice and voice copy, AV name and certificate number on record [R19 Sch VII 7.1-7.5, 8(v)-(vi); R26].
dpdp_act_rules: A new purpose for cross-sell: consent from ~2027-05-13/14 [S16; S18].
sector_rules: Solicitation and advice: only certified persons [R23; R19; R20; R22]. For brokers, "rendering advice" and "submitting quotation received from insurer/s" are core functions that cannot be outsourced [R20 Sch I Form A 1(c), (e); Sch II Form X 1(a)]. The insurer's commission policy decides what the new policy pays [R31].
platform_policy: WhatsApp marketing templates need opt-in and are capped per user [S29; S32].
penalties_enforcement: Promotion on 1600 draws graded action [S03 reg 25(4)(f)]; unscrubbed 140 calls draw complaint action [S03]; mis-selling falls under IRDAI [R23 def (9)].
status_today_2026_10_17: LWC for a certified human on 140xx; NOT-VIABLE for the AI in the wedge
verdict_post_sales: Keep out of the AI call. If the policyholder raises switching or price, the AI logs a callback request for a certified person, who calls separately (140 with consent, or inbound). This puts the "never promote in the call" rule under pressure if brokers win renewals mainly by re-quoting (critic A2(b)); test it in interviews.
kill_criterion_check: Not a kill by itself. But if most motor renewal value at the buyer comes from re-quotes, the AI's role shrinks to reminders and payment links, and the value gate (kill criteria 2 and 3) must be re-tested on that narrower role.

use_case: Lapse revival: life policy in lapsed (revivable) status; motor or health after expiry (motor break-in, health past the grace period)
direction_consent_class: outbound / former or lapsed customer (service or promotional, by case)
number_series: Life revival of a lapsed but existing contract: service, 1600 [R35 (bh)(i); R03] (inference: the contract still exists). Motor or health after expiry: the person may no longer be "its Customer" for "a product procured" -> service status UNCLEAR. The conservative path is 140 plus consent or scrubbing (inference).
dnd_ncpr_scrubbing: Service: not scrubbed. If treated as promotional: scrubbed, and BLOCK PROMO customers need registered consent.
digital_consent_acquisition: Inferred consent lasts for the "duration/discharge of the contract" [R36 memo para 39]; after expiry it is weaker (inference).
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
dpdp_act_rules: Life revival: contract purpose. Expired motor/health: legitimate-use basis weakens over time; take consent at the last in-force contact (inference).
sector_rules: Persuading revival or renewal is solicitation [R23]. Life renewal commission stays with the agent or intermediary of record while the policy is in force [R25 ch IX 46 for orphan policies; insurer board policy, R31].
status_today_2026_10_17: Life revival LWC (1600); motor/health post-expiry UNCLEAR
verdict_post_sales: Life revival: VIABLE under the U6-INS-1 conditions. Motor/health after expiry: run the reminder before expiry and inside any grace period; after that, a human or a consented 140 path.

use_case: Inbound callback, missed-call return and WhatsApp follow-up on a renewal
number_series: Inbound is not a commercial communication from the sender, so no TCCCPR series applies to the inbound leg. Use a DID or toll-free number, since vendor docs describe 1600 as outbound-only [R11]. A returned call is outbound: 1600 if service.
dlt_header_template_registration: N/A inbound; a returned call follows U6-INS-1.
digital_consent_acquisition: The customer-initiated contact is itself the basis; keep the record.
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
call_recording: IRDAI distance marketing explicitly covers "requests by prospects seeking information or sale" [R19 Sch VII 1(b)(iii); R22]. If an inbound call turns into a sale, the solicitation rules (certified person, recording notice) apply.
sector_rules: Inbound renewal service (status, premium, payment link) is servicing; advice and quotes go to a certified person [R20; R23].
platform_policy: WhatsApp: user-initiated messages are free inside 24 h; utility templates Rs 0.115 [S29; S31].

use_case: Renewal calls on books held by PoSPs or individual agents (calls placed by the individual, not by the intermediary or insurer entity)
number_series: UNCLEAR: the TRAI direction covers "entities regulated by IRDAI" and the IRDAI circular is addressed to insurers and intermediaries, not to individuals [R01; R03]. A PoSP is an individual engaged by an insurer or intermediary that is responsible for the PoSP's conduct [R34]. Calls placed by or for a platform or intermediary fall under its 1600 duty; a PoSP calling from a personal mobile is a grey area.
dlt_header_template_registration: An individual cannot readily register as a DLT Principal Entity (business documents are required) [R09; R11] (inference).
ai_disclosure_synthetic_voice: LWC: no TRAI rule requires telling the callee the voice is AI [S03; S14]; a call made to deceive is UCC [S02 def (bw)] -> never deny being AI; IT Rules 2026 synthetic-audio duty UNCLEAR for a B2B voice SaaS [S20]. IRDAI overlay: telephonic solicitation must disclose the Authorised Verifier's name and IRDAI certificate number and offer a language choice [R19 Sch VII 7.3(iii)]; an AI has neither -> open with AI disclosure + intermediary name + IRDAI CoR number (mirrors CA reg 25(2)(viii)) and never imply a certified person is speaking.
call_recording: As U6-INS-1 when the platform places the call.
dpdp_act_rules: The platform or intermediary is the data fiduciary; the PoSP acts under it (inference).
sector_rules: PoSPs sell only pre-underwritten lines (motor, PA, travel, home and similar) [R34]. From 2027-01-01 policies are tagged to the PoSP's functional identity [R18].
penalties_enforcement: The intermediary is liable for PoSP misconduct [R34 VI(3)].
status_today_2026_10_17: UNCLEAR for individual-placed calls; LWC when the platform places them
verdict_post_sales: Sell to the PoSP platform (a broker, CA or IMF) as U6-INS-1 or U6-INS-2, using the platform's 1600 CLI. Do not sell to individual PoSPs or agents.
